lede: Wat Photharam accounts for 40 catalogued manuscripts, 11 of them flagged research-priority. It clusters in Phayao (100% of the corpus for this temple). Nearly all (100%) are written in Tham Lanna · อักษรธรรมล้านนา script. By support it leans to palm-leaf · ใบลาน (70%) over mulberry paper (saa) · กระดาษสา (30%). Dated witnesses run 1867–1966 CE (14 of 40 carry a date).
